title: Monday Quick Tip
subtitle: New to the sport
hook: One player has never played before. Everyone else has.
intro: They do not know the rules yet.
Teammates are playing at a different level.
statement: New players need a way in that does not feel like being behind.
q1: Do you give new players extra teaching time —
q2: or let them learn alongside everyone else?
q3: What would help them feel part of the team?
t1: There is no perfect answer here. But new players stay
t2: when their first season feels welcoming.
cta: Coaches — how do you welcome new players?
ctaLines: A buddy. Extra minutes before practice. Same as everyone.
ctaPrompt: Share your habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
One player has never played before. Everyone else has.
They do not know the rules yet. Teammates are playing at a different level.
New players need a way in that does not feel like being behind.
Extra teaching time or learn with everyone. There is no single right way.
How do you welcome new players? Share your habit in the comments.
